items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Barrett came in when Freddie Kohlman Coleman left... Barrett stayed with all the different bands that was there.

ctx.x: We used to, you know -- I had my fiddle, and he'd have an old piece of drum. We'd be out on the curb stomp-playing. And he'd be running all up and down the curb with his drumsticks, drumming on the curb stones. He was doing that before Barrett (Deems) . Drumming on the picket fences, and things. Yeah. Humming. He always did that hum.
